authority: ADR-033 §2.2 — docs/architecture/decisions/ADR-033-forecast-likelihood-and-outlook.md. The bands below are BEACON's documented PRESENTATION bands over a probability signal a source already published. They are not calibrated-uncertainty language (they are deliberately NOT the IPCC likely>=0.66 / very-likely>=0.90 scale) and they are not an action trigger — anticipatory-action activation thresholds live in the EAP configuration, separately and per protocol.
boundaryConvention: Each band's lowerBound is INCLUSIVE and bands are evaluated highest-first, so exactly one class can match. Bands ascend in both lowerBound and class rank, which makes the mapping monotonic: a larger source value can never yield a less likely class. A value below `unclassifiedBelow` gets NO class at all (the record is still carried, with its raw value, geometry and provenance).

DERIVED_EXCEEDANCE_PROBABILITY.unit: dimensionless probability fraction in [0,1] — never a percentage, never rescaled
DERIVED_EXCEEDANCE_PROBABILITY.source: Copernicus GloFAS reporting points publish a derived probability of exceeding the point's 2-/5-/20-year return-period threshold (https://confluence.ecmwf.int/display/CEMS/GloFAS+Reporting+Points; verified in audit/DATA_SOURCE_VERIFICATION.md row 36, tier CACHED, account-gated). BEACON reads that published number and nothing else.
DERIVED_EXCEEDANCE_PROBABILITY.method: deterministic threshold lookup on the source-published derived exceedance probability — no model, no interpolation, no smoothing, no cross-source fusion. The class is shown with the raw source value beside it.

ENSEMBLE_MEMBER_FRACTION.sourceField: member fraction supplied by a cached forecast file (k of N members over the threshold)
ENSEMBLE_MEMBER_FRACTION.unit: dimensionless share of forecast members over the threshold in [0,1] — model spread, NOT a calibrated probability of occurrence and never displayed as a percentage chance
ENSEMBLE_MEMBER_FRACTION.source: Counting forecast members over a threshold is the published anticipatory-action pattern (IFRC GO trigger monitoring; anticipation-hub.org). BEACON has NO wired live ensemble source: a member fraction only enters from a cached/recorded file handed to the evaluator, labeled as such (finding F-34). Nothing in BEACON queries ensemble members at runtime.
ENSEMBLE_MEMBER_FRACTION.method: deterministic threshold lookup on the member share supplied with a cached forecast file. The share is reported verbatim as evidence beside the class, described as the share of forecast members over the threshold — never as a chance of occurrence.

CATEGORICAL_ADVISORY_TIER.sourceField: the source's own advisory tier, carried verbatim
CATEGORICAL_ADVISORY_TIER.source: Aggregators that publish an ordinal advisory tier rather than a number (MeteoAlarm-class low/medium/high awareness levels). Only tiers a source actually publishes may be listed here.
CATEGORICAL_ADVISORY_TIER.method: one-to-one mapping of the source's own published advisory tier onto the ordered class. No numeric probability is implied, computed, or displayed — an ordinal tier has none.
